description: Records of up to 20 ships at once from the AIS Trail archive, by mmsi and/or imo (lists): identity and particulars (name, IMO, call sign, type, flag from the MMSI, length, beam, estimated deadweight, first and last seen) and sanctions flags by IMO number from three official lists: OFAC SDN, UK Sanctions List and EU Regulation 833/2014 Annex XLII (list, programmes, date listed). An IMO number resolves to the MMSI that reported it last; ships not in the plan's sources come back with found false. Sanctions flags are informational, not a compliance determination: only ships a list names by IMO number are matched, ownership-based sanctions are not covered. Needs an AIS Trail API key sent by the MCP client as the HTTP header 'Authorization: Bearer ap_live_…'. Credits: 1 per ship returned (none for ships not found); the plan's sources and 24-hour delay (on plans without live data) apply.

imo.description: 7-digit IMO numbers; mmsi and imo together at most 20
